# autocomplete (bash-autocomplete)

> Fast tab completion for the stock macOS bash 3.2 (`/bin/bash`), written in C. A lightweight alternative to bash-completion: no Homebrew bash, no bash-completion package, no zsh, no shell scripts. Bundled completions for docker, git, kubectl, make, mvn, npm and killall; new commands are added with small YAML spec files.

Key facts:

- Registered with `complete -o nospace -C 'autocomplete _complete'`; every TAB runs the C binary directly. Shell startup loads nothing else.
- Install: `git clone https://github.com/hza/bash-autocomplete.git autocomplete && cd autocomplete && make install`, then open a new terminal. Init line: `eval "$(autocomplete bash)"`.
- In bash 3.2, `source <(autocomplete bash)` silently does nothing; use `eval "$(autocomplete bash)"`.
- Specs are YAML files named after the command, looked up in `$AUTOCOMPLETE_SPECS`, `~/.config/autocomplete`, then the bundled specs directory.
- License: MIT.

- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/hza/bash-autocomplete/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): common problems and fixes
